name: gsd-pilot
description: One keystroke to the right GSD move: a docked palette of the commands that fit now, verification status, capture and attach.

openOnStart.title: Open the pane on start
openOnStart.description: Dock the GSD pilot pane when a session starts in a GSD project (fullscreen layout only; on the main screen it waits for /gsd). /gsd opens it either way.
